why: tags a delivered message as typed, serialized or DYNAMIC; exists for the dynamic-message path. dynamic typesupport (Jazzy, REP-2011): messages whose type is learned at RUNTIME, held in `rosidl_dynamic_typesupport` dynamic data. Every type in an image is generated at build time into fixed storage (RFC-0023); dynamic data needs an allocator and a type-description parser at runtime. Same decision as `cpp:GenericPublisher`; see rmw `rmw_take_dynamic_message` (declined).
